shortPitch: We find interesting products so you don't have to spend hours searching.
description: PRIME.FINDS is an international product discovery brand curating interesting, useful, and stylish products worth knowing about.

contact.note: contact.email is offered automatically on every legal page and in the footer. The public issue tracker of the site's repository remains a second channel.

analytics.note: Cookieless Umami Cloud (cloud.umami.is). build.py injects the script and sets window.__PRIME_FINDS_ANALYTICS_CONFIG; js/core/analytics.js sends each Amazon click as an event named after the product.
